text:
Jurançon (French pronunciation: [ʒyʁɑ̃sɔ̃] ; Occitan: Juranson) is a commune in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques department in Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France. It is part of the traditional province of Béarn.
